subject.title: [Feature Request] ACP Session Skill Context Injection

question: Should ACP `sessions_spawn` gain a core OpenClaw skill-context contract now, and which selection modes plus redaction/audit/prompt-layer semantics are allowed?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but selecting explicit/default/auto behavior and deciding what trusted skill material can cross into ACP child harness prompts is a product and security boundary choice.

options.title: Design ACP contract first
options.body: Keep the issue open while maintainers specify allowed selection modes, redaction/audit metadata, prompt lifetime, resume behavior, and interaction with native/Codex skill contracts before implementation.

options.title: Ship explicit-only v1
options.body: Allow only an explicit per-spawn skill id list initially, with no automatic/default selection until the broader prompt contract is settled.

options.title: Defer to harness parity work
options.body: Block ACP injection on #95058 or a successor design if maintainers want one unified harness skill contract before any ACP-specific surface.

recommendation.title: Design ACP contract first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open while maintainers specify allowed selection modes, redaction/audit metadata, prompt lifetime, resume behavior, and interaction with native/Codex skill contracts before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the ACP thread-bound sessions surface that would need the new contract and are the strongest available ACP spawn history signal.
